candidates.title: Prepare small-business books for an accountant

demandEvidence.chore: Create invoices, categorize transactions and reconcile records while preparing books with an accountant.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I went into it to create invoices, categorize and reconcile transactions, and work with my accountant to prepare our books.

ease.reason: A beginner can test a small CSV of fictional transactions, though matching rules and categories need operator input.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent consultants may pay for bookkeeping preparation; the post establishes no payment for this service.

feasibility.reason: A four-week prototype can categorize supplied rows and flag unmatched entries; live accounting integrations are outside this evidence.

autonomy.reason: Rows can be processed repeatedly, but a person must verify categories, reconcile exceptions and approve records.

evidence.reason: The author names invoice creation, transaction categorization and reconciliation for accountant-supported books, without frequency or detailed rules.

candidates.reason: Below the equal-weight threshold: a synthetic transaction categorization and exception list is plausible, but evidence is limited to one author’s stated tasks and the five provisional ratings average 5.4.
